svg.text: The observability track on one picture: what it reads, the 22 rules on stg by round, and how an alert reaches a person
Live on stg (the environment in daily use)
R1 to R7: the round that added or changed it. page = Sev1, someone acts now; ticket = Sev3, next working day.

restarts; the server's CPU, storage, liveness

queue_job, ir_cron, table statistics, lock waits

The log reader, every 5 min (R2, R5, R6)

the file share read only; -> its own table

22 rules on stg: 17 log searches, 5 metric series
Red: pages. Every rule backtested on history, fired on dev on purpose, then preflighted on stg's live data.

How it is built and kept honest (live)

- CI in 4 jobs, offline, every tool pinned by SHA-256
- Drift at each session start; nothing in Azure names the repo
- About $19.35 a month billed (+ $0.23 data), $20 ceiling
